headline: Names a Tampa, Florida post office building after Major Andreas O'Keeffe.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 7521 Paula Drive in Tampa, Florida, as the "Major Andreas O'Keeffe Post Office Building." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018, and the new name applied from that date.
